answer: An agent market for jetty bookings requires every trading identity to lock 100 tokens in a contract for 30 days before it can bid, with one active account per deposit. An attacker can mirror an honest agent's software and let fake accounts wander through the market, but each identity needs fresh collateral. Running 10,000 identities therefore ties up one million tokens for a month, imposing a capital cost even if every account behaves correctly.
